this is the reusable firmware for you to flash even after you go back home
pip install esptool
esptool.py -p <port> write_flash 0x0 greyflag_merged.bin

then connect over USB to start the challenges:
pip install esp-idf-monitor
python -m esp_idf_monitor <port>     (<port> = /dev/ttyACM0 on Linux, COMx on Windows; exit with Ctrl-])
